_comment: Default DDD conformance rules (from rules/nestjs-ddd + decision cards). Project overrides via .claude/conformance.json (kind merge).

kinds._note: majority-only (no expectExtends) — BaseEntityId is the norm, but documented ADR exceptions exist (e.g. format-validation-only IDs)
majority-only (no expectExtends) — plain VOs vs legit specialized bases like PolishIdentifier

majority-only (no expectExtends) — CQRS command-side repos typically extend BaseKyselyRepository, but read-side query/projection repos and documented one-off exceptions (no event sourcing needed) legitimately skip it

_bodyRules_comment: Rules about the BODY of a file (check.mjs --ratchet turns them into a delta against a git baseline). Scope is command/query handlers ONLY: event handlers (BullMQ retry rethrows a failure on purpose) and processors are out of scope. Waiver: the rule's exceptionMarker comment WITH a reason, or an entry in .claude/conformance.json `exceptions` (rule + file + reason).

bodyRules.message: throw in a command/query handler file (also in private helper methods)
bodyRules.hint: return Result.fail(error); a justified exception needs `// THROW-EXCEPTION: <reason>` or an entry in .claude/conformance.json

bodyRules.message: BullMQ import or @InjectQueue in a command/query handler
bodyRules.hint: enqueue through a port (Symbol + interface in application, adapter in the module/infrastructure); exception: `// QUEUE-EXCEPTION: <reason>`

bodyRules.message: onFailed() override without @OnWorkerEvent('failed'): @nestjs/bullmq never wires it to the Worker (dead hook)
bodyRules.hint: add @OnWorkerEvent('failed') to the override. Note: adding it also revives BaseQueueProcessor.moveToDeadLetterQueue(), which logs the whole job.data — check PII redaction; exception: `// WORKER-EVENT-EXCEPTION: <reason>`

bodyRules.message: safeRun(() => commandBus.execute(...)) without throw: BaseCommandHandler returns Result.fail, so the failure is swallowed and the BullMQ job succeeds without retry
bodyRules.hint: const result = await this.commandBus.execute(cmd); if (result.isFailure) throw result.error; exception: `// SAFERUN-EXCEPTION: <reason>`

bodyRules.message: eventData key collides with a canonical BaseAuditHandler field: the canonical value is written after the spread and wins, so yours is lost
bodyRules.hint: pass the value in the typed `data` field when one exists, or use a non-colliding key (denialReason, not reason); the key list mirrors BaseAuditHandler.createAuditEntry (juz-ide-api family) — a project with another base overrides `keys` in .claude/conformance.json; exception: `// AUDIT-EVENTDATA-EXCEPTION: <reason>`

bodyRules.message: relative import leaves src/: without rootDir tsc moves the build output to dist/src/ (tsc --noEmit and tests stay green)
bodyRules.hint: keep the imported file under src/ (or read it at runtime instead of importing); exception: `// OUTSIDE-SRC-EXCEPTION: <reason>` and set rootDir in tsconfig.build.json
